// diagnostic

E1007

Malformed bit width in an `[U8]{"…"}` binary pattern hole — not `U<1..64>[be|le]` or `...` (D-BINPAT1 / D-UNIFYLIT1)

What

Malformed bit width in an `[U8]{"…"}` binary pattern hole — not `U<1..64>[be|le]` or `...` (D-BINPAT1 / D-UNIFYLIT1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1007

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1007: tests/ui/binpat_bad_width.stderr.

Error [E1007]: `U99` isn't a valid bit width in a binary pattern
  --> tests/ui/binpat_bad_width.jet:4:18
    |
  4 |         [U8]{"{x:U99}"} -> { print("x") }
    |                  ^^^
 Why: a bit field is `U` followed by a width of 1 to 64 bits, optionally with a `be`/`le` byte order
 Fix: write e.g. `U4`, `U8`, `U16be`, or `U32le`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1007
